info.title: CuiSharp.Tools - drive a CuiSharp app and read its docs from the command line
info.description: Bundle of the CuiSharp guide and API reference for offline reading, plus a driver that prints a CuiSharp app's controls, clicks and types into it, and saves its frame as a PNG - without a window, an agent SDK or a test project.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: inspect and drive a CuiSharp app, and read its rules offline.
